name: Sunder-class breaching carrier
role: Heavy articulated assault carrier: noses its armoured assault module straight into a breach (bunker wall, hab lock, barricade), drops the chevron prow ramp and puts a full Vigil assault section out of the front under its own armour; the rear power unit stays back and fires over it.
drive: tracked, two articulated units (4 track runs)
capacity: 10 Vigilants in full exosuit, standing-ready on grab rails (assault module)

weapons.main: Cleaver 90 mm short demolition gun in the rear-unit turret
weapons.secondary: cab-roof grenade launcher; prow-mounted smoke mortars

weapons.main: twin Hearth thermal lances in the rear turret (short range bunker clearing)
Rook 30 mm autocannon turret + point-defence laser on the cab

blockout_note: Overlapping primitive shells at 1:56 mm (visual blockout, not a unioned print mesh).
